title: Trump Administration Celebrates DOE Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program Hitting Criticality Goal
detail: President Trump and the Department of Energy formally celebrated on July 24, 2026 having met — and exceeded — the goal set in Trump's May 2025 executive order 'Reforming Nuclear Reactor Testing at the Department of Energy': bringing advanced test reactors to criticality by July 4, 2026. DOE's Reactor Pilot Program at Idaho National Laboratory ultimately brought four privately built microreactors to criticality ahead of the deadline — Antares Nuclear's Mark-0, Valar Atomics' Ward 250, Deployable Energy's Unity, and Aalo Atomic's Aalo-X — which the administration touted as proof of a deregulated, fast-tracked approach to nuclear licensing outside the traditional NRC process.

media.caption: DOE announces advanced reactors met Trump's July 4 criticality deadline
